properties.title: Roof Material
properties.description: A U-Net with a ResNet-34 encoder that maps roofs in RGB drone and aerial imagery as metal sheet, thatch or other roof (asbestos, concrete) and returns them as polygons. Trained on OpenAerialMap drone imagery of Nacala, Mozambique, with OpenStreetMap roof:material tags, and finetunable in fAIr on roofs labelled in a new area.
properties.mlm:name: unet-roof-material

providers.name: Oluwasola Oyinloye
providers.description: Trained the U-Net on OpenAerialMap imagery and OpenStreetMap roof tags of Nacala and exported it to ONNX.

fair:metrics_spec.name: Metal sheet IoU
fair:metrics_spec.description: Intersection over union of predicted and labelled metal sheet roof pixels, summed over all validation chips.

fair:metrics_spec.name: Metal sheet precision
fair:metrics_spec.description: Share of pixels predicted as metal sheet that are labelled metal sheet.

fair:metrics_spec.name: Metal sheet recall
fair:metrics_spec.description: Share of labelled metal sheet pixels that the model predicts as metal sheet.

fair:metrics_spec.name: Thatch IoU
fair:metrics_spec.description: Intersection over union of predicted and labelled thatch roof pixels, summed over all validation chips.

fair:metrics_spec.name: Thatch precision
fair:metrics_spec.description: Share of pixels predicted as thatch that are labelled thatch.

fair:metrics_spec.name: Thatch recall
fair:metrics_spec.description: Share of labelled thatch pixels that the model predicts as thatch.

fair:metrics_spec.name: Other roof IoU
fair:metrics_spec.description: Intersection over union of predicted and labelled other roof (asbestos, concrete) pixels, summed over all validation chips.

fair:metrics_spec.name: Other roof precision
fair:metrics_spec.description: Share of pixels predicted as other roof that are labelled other roof.

fair:metrics_spec.name: Other roof recall
fair:metrics_spec.description: Share of labelled other roof pixels that the model predicts as other roof.

fair:metrics_spec.name: Mean roof IoU
fair:metrics_spec.description: Mean of the metal sheet, thatch and other roof IoU. Pixels of roofs with an unknown material are left out of every score.

fair:split_spec.description: Chips named OAM-<x>-<y>-<z>.tif are grouped into block_size x block_size tile blocks, and whole blocks go to train or validation, so the model is scored on areas it did not train on. Of 200 seeded shuffles of the blocks, the one that holds out each roof class closest to the validation ratio is kept, so a rare material is still scored. Other chip names, or a dataset inside a single block, are held out chip by chip.

fair:hyperparameters_spec.name: Learning rate schedule
fair:hyperparameters_spec.description: Cosine decay of the learning rate to zero over training, or a constant rate.

fair:hyperparameters_spec.name: Gradient clipping
fair:hyperparameters_spec.description: Maximum gradient norm per training step.

fair:hyperparameters_spec.name: Freeze encoder
fair:hyperparameters_spec.description: Train only the U-Net decoder, which suits very small datasets.

fair:hyperparameters_spec.name: Maximum class weight
fair:hyperparameters_spec.description: Cap on the cross-entropy weight of a rare roof class, which is the square root of background share over class share in the training pixels.

fair:hyperparameters_spec.name: Validation ratio
fair:hyperparameters_spec.description: Share of chips held out for validation.

fair:hyperparameters_spec.name: Split seed
fair:hyperparameters_spec.description: Random seed for the train and validation split and for training.

fair:hyperparameters_spec.name: Split block size
fair:hyperparameters_spec.description: Width in tiles of the square blocks the spatial split keeps together.

fair:hyperparameters_spec.name: Confidence threshold
fair:hyperparameters_spec.description: Minimum probability of a pixel's most likely roof class for the pixel to be kept as roof; 0 keeps every pixel whose most likely class is a roof.

mlm:output.name: class logits
mlm:output.description: One logit per class for every pixel; their softmax gives the class probabilities.
